final: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_invoice) SELECT AVG(per_invoice.avg_cost), AVG(per_invoice.avg_ratio), AVG(per_invoice.avg_ratio - overall.mean_ratio) FROM per_invoice CROSS JOIN overall WHERE per_invoice.avg_ratio > overall.mean_ratio
